proof_attempt_summary: D0 derived an exact-cap phase result, a bounded signed-slack frontier, and a randomized exact-binomial safe-regret map for positive budgets. A targeted Hellinger-contraction proof repair cleared the D0.5 math and decision panels, and the Massart citation was attested from the original article's author-uploaded abstract. The honest-width frontier outside the proved regimes remains open; D0.5 graded the narrow delivered package incremental, below the field floor.
tldr: For one uncensored initiation time and a constant support-preserving hazard multiplier, the causal objective is optimal value under a budget on additional people initiating by time \(1\). Exact randomized binomial inversion gives a matching local minimax safe-regret map for every positive admissible budget. At the exact cap, both safe regret and honest width change from a polynomial-over-logarithm order to \(1/\log n\) and then a nonvanishing order at \(a=1/(2M-1)\). In bounded signed cap slack with \(0<a<1\), safe regret has order \(G_{s,n}\) and honest width has order \(G_{c,n}+n^{-1/2}\), where \(G_{c,n}\asymp q_n\); the width upper bound includes the expected rank-estimation error. Fixed positive slack below the critical exponent and zero budget have separate proved width orders, while other positive-budget honest-width regimes retain an explicit bracket.
gap: Optimal-value intervals with estimated stochastic constraints and local minimax optimizer bounds are established in stochastic programming. Their inspected theorems do not give a joint uniform-safety, positive-part-regret, and honest expected-width frontier for a triangular law-dependent feasible set whose endpoint-count derivative vanishes at a multiplier cap.
